scope.publisherSupply: period-key envelopes and item wraps; no sealed content key; no chain key
steps: render A: partial grant of the current period; the client opens A and keeps that period key
render B: the kept period key opens B with no issuer call
render C, an hour later: the next period is not granted; 401, nothing cached or opened

discovery: a leaf root found by discoverFixturePackageRoots (js/test-tools/claim-index.js); verification/fixtures/v1/ and v1/profiles/ are path segments, not packages

consumers.description: replays the recorded markup through the real Browser and IssuerServer and holds the assertions
tests the package check: membership, checksums, regeneration and refusals
membership both ways, per-member sha256 and a fresh recording; writes nothing

limitations: All claim decisions are incomplete; this package decides no claim.
It proves the period-key-only supply path through the real JavaScript issuer and client only.
No chain keys, no client-bound transport and no independent conformance.
The publisher is not replayed: renders are recorded markup, and ES256 signatures are retained values, not reproducible bytes.
One issuer, direct transport and ECDH-P256 envelopes only.
